title: Turkey keema with peas
summary: Turkey breast mince cooked down with tomato, ginger and peas, the way a keema should be, with a modest scoop of basmati on the side.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and fry the onion until it starts to colour. Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander and turmeric and stir for a minute.
Add the turkey and break it up with a spoon. Cook until the mince has lost its pink colour and any liquid has evaporated.
steps.tip: If you leave the liquid in, the keema tastes boiled. Let it fry for a minute at the end.

steps.instruction: Stir in the tomatoes, garam masala, salt and peas. Cover and simmer until the peas are hot and the sauce is thick, not watery.
Cook the rice in the water with a pinch of salt while the keema simmers. Serve the keema with the rice and the sliced chilli.
